description: Cipher learning, Focus combat ownership, locked-tier rejection and progression in real BGEE through the installed campaign XP cap.
prerequisites: Disposable legal BGEE fixture with Cipher, the read-only checkpoint helper and a legally created Cipher actor or its private save.
Controlled hostile and friendly targets with normal hits, critical hits and misses observed in real combat.
Ordinary and temple rest access, a second area and local saves; XP grants only prepare real level-up screens.
Independent installed-rule oracles for Focus gain/cap/cost, learning credits and tier unlocks.
Before preparation, hash and read installed XPCAP and XPLEVEL rows; derive attainable levels from those resources. Controlled XP may reach the installed cap but must not change or bypass it.
instructions: Record starting Focus and before/after Focus for hostile normal/critical hits, misses and friendly attacks; reach the cap and attempt further gain.
Exercise power learning confirm/cancel, casting/spending, target cancellation and quickslot casting through the actual UI.

Compare visible learning eligibility and rejection of locked tiers against installed rules in cipher.tier-restrictions, including inaccessible Reaping Knives. Its ownership/combat tests are mandatory in the separate BG2EE/ToB scenario; do not grant the power or raise the BGEE cap to simulate access.

Use real low/middle level-up screens and advance to the maximum level permitted by installed XPCAP/XPLEVEL. Record cap XP, expected/observed level, learning credits and tier eligibility in cipher.level.cap.
Compare observed Focus/powers after ordinary rest, temple rest, an area transition and save/reload with the documented reset/persistence rules. Quit normally.
